description: Full detail for one finding: evidence, affected URLs, remediation, machine-readable agentActions, and a composed copy-pasteable fixPrompt. findingId is the stable id from index365_list_findings (f_...), or a 1-based ordinal like '3' into the run's findings ordered by severity (critical first) then findingId. Pass runId for one run, domain for that domain's latest completed run, or neither for the organization's most recent completed run; the response carries a resolved block naming the run that was read. Best for: pulling the exact fix instruction before editing a repo. Not for: discovery (call index365_list_findings first). Common mistake: re-deriving a fix when fixPrompt and agentActions already specify it. Example: index365_get_finding({ findingId: 'f_ab12cd34' }). Next: apply the fix, then index365_start_scan to confirm it is resolved.

domain.description: Domain or URL resolved to its project's latest completed run (www. is ignored; any subdomain of a project's domain matches). Alternative to runId; omit both for the latest completed run.

findingId.description: Stable finding id (f_...), or a 1-based ordinal ('1') in severity order

runId.description: Run the finding belongs to (omit to resolve by domain, or to the latest completed run)

name: index365_get_finding
title: Get one finding
